2610.36068.update_target: Robot-policy learning and LoRA updates to an action-conditioned world model
2610.36068.mechanism_en: World-model rollback branches at critical decisions and converts counterfactual outcomes into action supervision. Real policy transitions then correct model dynamics, supporting another round of policy improvement.
2610.36068.boundary_en: These are author-reported physical experiments initialized from teleoperation, not independent reproduction. Counterfactual labels depend on model fidelity; training time and real interaction are not free.

2610.36077.update_target: Verified simulated worlds, reusable capability modules and a routed external harness tree
2610.36077.mechanism_en: Creator abstracts shared capability requirements into worlds; Explorer evolves modules through selective inheritance; Evolver uses verified traces to reorganize tasks into capabilities. Validated updates accumulate within a fixed tree topology.
2610.36077.boundary_en: The tree topology is fixed during accumulation, and capability routing uses public task information. Finite benchmark transfer does not prove unbounded recursion; the inspected repository says code is coming soon.

2610.36188.update_target: Repository-specific procedural skills maintained from validated pull-request streams
2610.36188.mechanism_en: PR implementation/review evidence becomes executable knowledge. Skills guide subsequent code, tests, documentation and compatibility changes; later execution/CI outcomes feed the next skill update.
2610.36188.boundary_en: A plausible feedback loop is not itself an established gain. Separate skills learned from prior validated PRs from target-PR leakage, and validate changed conventions rather than retaining them indefinitely.

2610.36469.update_target: A shared RL policy and a population of executable harness code
2610.36469.mechanism_en: Policy rollouts across harnesses train the policy, while a proposer revises harness code from current execution traces during training. Population feedback prevents an interface from remaining fixed as the policy changes.
2610.36469.boundary_en: This updates model parameters as well as external code. Budget-matched comparisons and generalization tests are essential; a harness-only result cannot substitute for a jointly trained-policy comparison.

2610.36578.update_target: Audio reasoning policy weights and the periodically refreshed critic supplying process rewards
2610.36578.mechanism_en: One model generates reasoning as actor and pairwise-judges paths as critic. Refreshing the critic from the current policy makes the next training signal depend on the improved model and the same audio evidence.
2610.36578.boundary_en: Self-judgment is not ground truth or independent verification. External LLM judging and keyword analysis support behavior claims but do not prove universal acoustic faithfulness or unlimited improvement.

2610.36618.update_target: Executable exploration policies guiding combinatorial-program discovery
2610.36618.mechanism_en: Recorded searches form an experience world. A policy agent replays exploration strategies against program quality and search-step cost, then transfers selected policies to guide later program proposals.
2610.36618.boundary_en: The changed policy is an executable search procedure, not necessarily LLM-weight training. Experience replay and its construction have costs; cross-COP transfer remains bounded by the evaluated tasks.

2610.36660.update_target: Parent-agent harness revisions informed by population-wide task and modification records
2610.36660.mechanism_en: A distilled population block combines recurring failures, complementary successes and effects of previous modifications. The selected parent uses this evidence to revise its harness for subsequent evolution.
2610.36660.boundary_en: Population coverage is an oracle union, not deployable single-agent success. Distillation and evaluation cost must be counted; the released setup requires substantial disk and multi-day benchmark runs.

2610.36811.update_target: Model knowledge via state-conditioned post-training interventions and persistent intervention history
2610.36811.mechanism_en: Graph units connect diagnosis to intervention. Each round estimates availability, accessibility or usability, chooses corresponding knowledge exposure/CPT/SFT and re-evaluates before choosing the next update.
2610.36811.boundary_en: Knowledge-state labels are diagnostic estimates, not direct observation of internal truth. A persistent low score does not imply an unchanged bottleneck, and the method includes weight-training costs.

2610.36826.update_target: External behavioral rubrics, their priorities and the harness they supervise
2610.36826.mechanism_en: Execution trajectories continually reveal/reassess criteria and unresolved weaknesses. Prioritized rubrics target the next harness update while the task objective remains fixed.
2610.36826.boundary_en: Updating a rubric must preserve the fixed objective rather than lower standards. Model-based supervision can drift; no independent long-run validation was performed for this digest.

2610.36848.update_target: Supervisor-generated team roles, prompts and workflow, plus persistent learning files
2610.36848.mechanism_en: A supervisor diagnoses plateaus and restructures agents without editing the solution itself. Teams produce candidates; fixed evaluation and accumulated transcripts/artifacts guide the next team configuration.
2610.36848.boundary_en: Extended-budget claims differ from matched-budget comparisons; the remaining 11 MLA workloads are slower. Public repository measurements differ in some settings, so figures in these notes follow the saved official abstract.

2610.37046.update_target: Teacher-evolved reconstruction harness; executor parameters, action semantics and backend fixed
2610.37046.mechanism_en: Development reconstructions supply feedback to a stronger teacher that revises the external procedure. The resulting harness is frozen for unseen-scene execution without teacher assistance.
2610.37046.boundary_en: Deployment savings exclude neither teacher search nor development evaluation from lifecycle cost. Reconstruction metric gains are not physical execution or world-model truth; teacher-free inference is distinct from teacher-free development.

2610.35966.update_target: Controller routing memory, specialist configuration and per-step procedural skills
2610.35966.mechanism_en: A reflector assigns each diagnosed failure to its owning update scope and proposes one edit. Backbone-independent guards restrict admission to incremental bounded changes for reuse across tasks.
2610.35966.boundary_en: These are context-level external updates, not model fine-tuning. Guarded scope limits structural drift but does not independently establish task correctness or broad-domain generalization.

2610.35981.update_target: LoRA tool-use behavior trained from executable effect-typed traces
2610.35981.mechanism_en: Tool declarations enable replay checking and compiler-style optimization of traces. Verified positive demonstrations teach safe/economical programs that are reused on held-out tasks and an unseen domain.
2610.35981.boundary_en: The adapter changes weights; labels need not be human-written for training to have cost. Effect declarations and replay assumptions define safety, and refusal-data filtering has external BFCL tradeoffs.

2610.36153.update_target: Persistent repository knowledge and cross-session experience notes
2610.36153.mechanism_en: A tiered text/structure store and page-safe tools preserve prior root-cause findings, failed approaches and evidence boundaries. A fresh agent can reuse notes authored by a different model.
2610.36153.boundary_en: This small study measures root-cause-file localization, not successful repair or unlimited repository learning. KV-byte ratios and retrieval latency do not include every construction/model-inference cost.

2610.36533.update_target: Reusable robot programs, executable skills and object-centric physical knowledge
2610.36533.mechanism_en: A hierarchical knowledge base links affordances, spatial relations and action effects. Scene grounding and self-designed experiments test expected physical effects, resolve uncertainties and support later program search.
2610.36533.boundary_en: Knowledge acquisition uses embodied data and online solving. A larger library correlating with better search does not isolate its causal contribution or establish recursive improvement of the entire research method.

2610.36652.update_target: External memory-rule content and role/context-specific applicability meta-memory
2610.36652.mechanism_en: Single-memory versus no-memory comparisons diagnose defects. Candidate repairs are checked on current and earlier tasks; use histories separately learn when the owning role should apply or avoid a rule.
2610.36652.boundary_en: Training-free means no weight updates, not zero executions. Team failure alone cannot identify a bad rule; repair validity and applicability must be tested separately.

2610.36925.update_target: Separate world-model and policy LoRA adapters sharing a VLM latent interface
2610.36925.mechanism_en: Real transitions supervise recurrent latent dynamics; imagined trajectories train actor/critic behavior, and alternating real-data refresh adapts the world model. Future images need not be decoded.
2610.36925.boundary_en: The base backbone is frozen but adapters are trained. Environment protocols differ: the public notes specify a fixed world model and behavior-cloning support for EB-ALFRED; initial release lacks several environment entry points and datasets.

2610.36967.update_target: Source-validated temporal memory and replay-assessed behavioral regularities
2610.36967.mechanism_en: Events support trajectory facts; historical replay evaluates candidate regularities before matching them to current conditions. Later observations can change eligibility or confidence rather than treating recurrence as universal.
2610.36967.boundary_en: This is longitudinal benchmark evidence, not deployed-service benefit or universal causality. Opportunity labels, observation coverage and intervention controls shape the comparison.

2610.37482.update_target: Current task-advancement state and reusable GUI operation memory
2610.37482.mechanism_en: Verified local progress updates remaining goals during execution. After a task, supervision abstracts useful interactions from success and failure alike, preserving inputs, expected effects and verification conditions.
2610.37482.boundary_en: Within-task state and cross-task learned operations are separate contributions. Per-solved-task costs depend on success and accounting; verified local progress need not imply correct final task completion.

2610.37651.update_target: Prompt-optimizer task selection and retrieved prior-success context
2610.37651.mechanism_en: The curator filters likely noisy failure signals and retrieves earlier successful trajectories for selected tasks. The existing optimizer then revises prompts using the curated experience.
2610.37651.boundary_en: Curated prompt learning is external adaptation, not proof that the model or curator autonomously improves. Filtering may discard genuine hard failures; count curation/retrieval and selection bias.

2610.35962.update_target: Task-local Lean proof attempts through a fixed simple execution harness
2610.35962.mechanism_en: Efficient Lean 4 feedback and reflection keep a single attempt working without imposed decomposition/search. Matched-model and interface ablations compare this with specialized workflows.
2610.35962.boundary_en: Pass@1 can contain substantial test-time computation. Proof search does not establish persistent cross-task self-improvement, and stronger models or larger budgets must not be credited to a workflow change.

2610.35992.update_target: Measurement of guidance arrival relative to actual first source mutation
2610.35992.mechanism_en: The audit separates assignment, eligibility, trigger, delivery and content change, hashing Python files around executed actions. Local live runs are distinguished from unsynchronized public traces.
2610.35992.boundary_en: This does not establish repair correctness, planning benefit or shell-first coverage. Seven passing post-hoc arms include four with incomplete regression selectors.

2610.36109.update_target: Evaluation of committed weight, adapter or memory-update histories before each answer
2610.36109.mechanism_en: Control Map separates behavior, acquisition, retention, locality and transfer, and records update order/timing. Formal count-equivalence statements are tested against scheduling and editing experiments.
2610.36109.boundary_en: Equal update counts are not equal interventions. Theoretical conclusions require their stated assumptions, and acquisition alone does not certify retention or preservation of unrelated behavior.

2610.36114.update_target: Evidence delivery through the tool-output/context pipeline
2610.36114.mechanism_en: Raw result replay and controlled cutting compare unsafe fixed-length JSON slicing with alternative evidence delivery, independently of the nominal context-window capacity.
2610.36114.boundary_en: The controlled experiment supports extra-work costs; whether cutting causes the observed accuracy gap remains open. A large empty context window does not guarantee the model actually receives evidence.

2610.36143.update_target: External attack/defense programs under fixed model parameters
2610.36143.mechanism_en: Two eight-generation driving/humanoid cases generate code from tested opponent artifacts and mission feedback, then evaluate frozen programs to expose local co-adaptation.
2610.36143.boundary_en: The paper explicitly does not establish sustained robustness. Simulation/case-study software responses are not broad real-world security guarantees; no operational attack recipes are reproduced here.

2610.36308.update_target: Evaluation of stale competing facts after the correct update has been retrieved
2610.36308.mechanism_en: Equal-size four-statement interventions replace unrelated evidence with an obsolete competitor under frozen prompts. Gold-assisted post-hoc audits distinguish retrieval presence from correct use.
2610.36308.boundary_en: Gold-assisted diagnostics are not a deployable memory selector. This is a narrow single-hop consolidation result, not evidence that larger contexts or retrieval are universally harmful.

2610.36434.update_target: Evaluation of autonomous kernel optimization with only goals/constraints
2610.36434.mechanism_en: A general agent builds its own evaluation loop. Same-model/same-shape comparisons and mechanism ablations test whether specialized domain machinery adds value.
2610.36434.boundary_en: Operator shapes, hardware and permitted scope matter. A goal-only baseline still has a general agent/tool runtime and compute; its gains do not mean all domain expertise is useless.

2610.36511.update_target: Claim-level novelty verification for autonomous research proposals
2610.36511.mechanism_en: Temporal ground truth evaluates copied, disputed and later-realized ideas. ClaimNov attributes prior-art evidence to claims so one established contribution need not veto an entire new proposal.
2610.36511.boundary_en: Novelty is relative to retrieved/provided prior work, not universal proof of originality. Historical evaluation and ICLR acceptance are not substitutes for validating a new scientific result.

2610.36589.update_target: Evaluation probes/interface contracts and a failure-derived reusable infrastructure skill
2610.36589.mechanism_en: Hidden probes and task prompts are jointly synthesized to expose missing official-test requirements without hiding required interfaces. Error analysis becomes a skill checked on later infrastructure tasks.
2610.36589.boundary_en: Passing original tests is not adequate correctness. Benchmark prompts/probes define the evaluation, and storage/build savings differ from training or deployment savings; the abstract’s 10.5% is not silently relabeled as percentage points.

2610.36767.update_target: Evaluation of proof graders and an inference-time bandit score-selection method
2610.36767.mechanism_en: Expert-graded USAMO candidates and generated adversarial proofs probe verifier errors. MABGrader selects over discrete scores rather than taking a single opaque grade.
2610.36767.boundary_en: Natural-language grading is not machine-checked proof certification. The verified TROJAN release contains a generation/benchmark pipeline; a separate MABGrader implementation was not established by that repository.

2610.36947.update_target: Evidence admission, specialist-context scaling and interpretation of verifier feedback
2610.36947.mechanism_en: Five frozen studies compare model verdicts with deterministic scopes and validation. Corrupted evidence packages separate a valid artifact from unsupported claims about what it proves.
2610.36947.boundary_en: These are descriptive studies with limited coverage, including only 96 assessed cases in one 160-case arm and an unsupported test-adapter bug. More feedback or consensus is not automatically stronger assurance.

2610.37201.update_target: Audit of skill-edit acceptance noise and induced execution/token costs
2610.37201.mechanism_en: Identical-to-seed candidate replay measures selection-only dev gains. Bipartite turn/text attribution connects extra inputs to repeated checking and serialized action behavior.
2610.37201.boundary_en: These are evaluated optimizer settings, not proof all skill learning fails. The public analysis code omits recorded runs and its harness-bench dependency, limiting fresh-clone reproduction.

2610.37228.update_target: Evaluation of agent-driven recommendation engineering and idea generation
2610.37228.mechanism_en: Six industrial-style tasks compare three models and three harnesses. Trajectory analyses distinguish tuning/ensembling from algorithm invention, and injected external ideas test an ideation bottleneck.
2610.37228.boundary_en: Better metrics do not automatically establish algorithmic innovation or a recursively improving researcher. The paper-linked repository currently contains only a README, so it receives a Project link.

2610.37255.update_target: Policy weights and harness-induced action preferences assessed separately
2610.37255.mechanism_en: Under KL-regularized control, ceiling and policy mismatch decompose deployed return. Controlled field-order changes and retraining distinguish interface potential from compatibility with a fixed policy.
2610.37255.boundary_en: The decomposition is conditional theory, with exact small-environment and stronger-model surrogate diagnostics in different settings. A fixed-policy harness loss need not mean a lower attainable ceiling.

2610.37276.update_target: Search-time and final-confirmation evaluation allocation for scaffold evolution
2610.37276.mechanism_en: Fully evaluated warm-up calibrates a shared informative core and fixed item parameters. Sparse search is followed by refitting and paired successive halving that reuses observations and fills missing cells.
2610.37276.boundary_en: The listing’s method macro is resolved from official HTML. Evaluation cells are not total model calls or wall time; model fit, confirmation and calibration leakage remain important limits.

2610.37434.update_target: Evaluation of successive feature edits on the agent’s own persistent code
2610.37434.mechanism_en: History-derived stage contracts and executable F2P/P2P checks test new behavior and preservation. One session/workspace continues without external test feedback or rollback.
2610.37434.boundary_en: Feature/code evolution is not itself agent learning. The no-feedback/no-rollback protocol and persistent errors explain a specific evaluation boundary, not every software-development workflow.

2610.37624.update_target: Memory selection and attribution effects on group decisions
2610.37624.mechanism_en: CrossProfile crosses ownership of fixed supporting/decoy/irrelevant facts with verified answers. Attribution removal/randomization holds text and line order fixed to test social-proof effects.
2610.37624.boundary_en: Rare or relevant is not equivalent to decision-supporting. Controlled hidden-profile tasks and natural discussion have different loss mechanisms; a memory heuristic cannot recover evidence never expressed.

2610.37649.update_target: Evaluation of free scientific exploration and evidence-guided scene evolution
2610.37649.mechanism_en: Explorers manipulate altered-physics worlds and design tools without a research question or hints. Separate model agents generate/review scenes and assess reports using the hidden laws and execution records.
2610.37649.boundary_en: These are authored simulated laws with model-based review, not discoveries of unknown real-world physics. Autonomous environment evolution does not alone prove that the explorer becomes a better scientist.
